description: This file contains implementation code for board-specific configuration overrides for the Prometheus engine control system, including setting default engine parameters, pin configurations, serial and SPI settings, and other hardware-specific overrides.

methods.name: setPrometheusDefaults
methods.description: Initializes default engine configuration parameters specific to the Prometheus board, including engine mode, trigger type, cylinders, firing order, ignition, injection modes, trigger offset, displacement, RPM limits, sensor types, and TPS voltage thresholds.

methods.name: setPinConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Overrides pin configurations for injection and ignition pins, depending on the hardware version (e.g., STM32F469xx).

methods.name: setSerialConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Configures serial port settings, including enabling serial port and setting TX/RX pins and speed.

methods.name: setSdCardConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Enables SD card SPI interface and sets chip select pin.

methods.name: setBoardConfigurationOverrides
methods.description: Main function that applies all board-specific configurations, including delay for SWD trigger, setting ADC channels, pin modes, SPI configurations, CAN bus, and other hardware features based on the is469 flag.
